text: Miss Giddens takes her first post as governess at Bly, a country estate where a bachelor uncle keeps his orphaned niece and nephew, [on condition that she never troubles him|trigger|saying yes to an offer]. Flora is sweet, and Miles, sent home from boarding school, is charming beyond his years. Then she begins to see [a man and a woman in the grounds that only she seems to notice|rules|only some can see it], the dead valet Quint and the previous governess, and comes to believe they are [reaching into the children's bodies|threat|being taken over] to carry on [their cruel love affair|wrong|cruelty at home].
